test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - Quant (Held On 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A car starts a 360 km journey with a full tank. For the first 150 km, it travels at 60 km/h. Due to fuel reduction, the speed drops by 10 km/h for the next 120 km. For the remaining journey, it further slows by 10 km/h. Estimate the average speed for the whole journey.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Time₁ = 150 ÷ 60 = 2.5 h

Time₂ = 120 ÷ 50 = 2.4 h

Time₃ = (360 − 270) ÷ 40 = 2.25 h

Average Speed = 360 ÷ (2.5 + 2.4 + 2.25) = 360 ÷ 7.15 ≈ 50 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 50 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance = 360 km

First segment = 150 km at 60 km/h

Second segment = 120 km at (60 − 10) = 50 km/h

Third segment = 360 − (150 + 120) = 90 km at (50 − 10) = 40 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e92494d0ca03f73ec766b0fe7d9d9c92fadede95b32982c7000c74805a42c95.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Time for 1st part (t₁) = 150 ÷ 60 = 2.5 hours

⇒ Time for 2ⁿd part (t₂) = 120 ÷ 50 = 2.4 hours

⇒ Remaining distance = 360 − 270 = 90 km

⇒ Time for 3rd part (t₃) = 90 ÷ 40 = 2.25 hours

⇒ Total Time = 2.5 + 2.4 + 2.25 = 7.15 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 360 ÷ 7.15

⇒ Average Speed ≈ 50.35 km/h

⇒ Rounding to the nearest option, we get 50 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 50 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Equal Distances

If a journey is divided into two equal distances with speeds u and v, the average speed is given by the harmonic mean: 2uv ÷ (u + v).

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, relative speed = S₁ − S₂. In opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert from m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.</p
